items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did they have a dancer and MC? In those days, sometimes, they’d have an MC, a shake dancer, a comedian, then the musicians? [INTERVIEWEE] Something like that.

ctx.x: I wasn’t the main act, but they let me play.
